verdict.rationale: Fellow offers webhooks that fire HTTP POSTs on events (e.g., note generated, action item completed) and a REST API to act on that data, which can be wired into external automation, but there's no evidence of a native, user-facing rule-builder where an AI-native user declaratively defines 'if X event then Y action' logic inside Fellow itself — it requires custom code/infrastructure to consume webhooks and trigger actions. Missing for 10: a built-in rules/automation engine, no-code trigger-action configuration UI, and any documented example of an end-to-end automated rule execution.
